title: Learn and Look A-Z
hook: A good answer can survive another look.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: clean 3D classroom storybook, colorful supplies, simple desks, isolated objects; visual identity: Learn and Look A-Z

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a curious child verifying classroom claims
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: concrete object fact plus what it can and cannot establish
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Learn and Look A-Z an evidence habit: observe a clue, ask a question, consult a source or tool, and check the answer; cards and charts are prompts, not magic containers of knowledge.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: The child practices uncertainty and verification—seeing starts an idea, but books, measurements, maps, and questions help test it.
